questions.question_text: When is the tuition fee for the Associate Degree in Economics usually payable?
options: At the end of the degree
On a semester basis
Daily
Annually only
questions.explanation: FJWU, like most public universities, operates on a semester system where fees are collected at the start of every semester.

questions.question_text: What does the 'Miscellaneous Charges' component in the fee structure usually cover?
options: Personal transport costs
Library, sports, and student fund contributions
Books for the entire degree
Hostel room rent
questions.explanation: Miscellaneous charges are typically institutional fees that support student services, facilities, and extracurricular activities.

questions.question_text: How are security deposits handled after the completion of the Associate Degree?
options: They are donated to the university fund
They are refundable upon clearance of all university dues
They are automatically applied to the next degree level
They are non-refundable under any circumstances
questions.explanation: Security deposits are held by the university and returned to the student after they have officially cleared all library, department, and accounts dues.

questions.question_text: Which category of costs is generally included under 'Semester Fees' at FJWU?
options: Transportation costs only
Tuition, registration, and laboratory/library access
Hostel accommodation fees
External exam registration fees
questions.explanation: The standard semester fee is a consolidated amount covering instructional costs and basic access to academic facilities.

questions.question_text: What happens if a student fails to pay the fee by the due date?
options: Immediate expulsion from the university
A late fine is applied according to university policy
Automatic course withdrawal
The student is barred from using the library forever
questions.explanation: FJWU, like most institutions, applies a standard late fee penalty for payments received after the stipulated deadline.

questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of the 'Endowment Fund' fee component often found in public sector university fee structures?
options: Payment for student cafeteria
Support for long-term university sustainability and financial aid
Library late fees
Sports kit fees
questions.explanation: Endowment funds are used to build the university's financial reserves and provide scholarships for future students.

questions.question_text: When are 'Lab/Computer Charges' typically applicable in the Associate Degree in Economics?
options: Only when the student fails a course
Whenever the curriculum involves quantitative/econometric lab work
Every semester, regardless of the courses taken
Only during the final semester
questions.explanation: Lab charges are associated with the usage of computing facilities required for courses like Econometrics or Statistical Analysis.

questions.question_text: Are fee structures at FJWU subject to change between academic years?
options: Never, they are fixed for the life of the university
Only every 10 years
Yes, they can be revised by the university syndicate
Only if the student body votes
questions.explanation: University governing bodies have the authority to revise fee structures periodically to adjust for inflation and operational costs.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is usually non-refundable after a student graduates or leaves the program?
options: Security Deposit
Admission Processing Fee
Semester Tuition Fee
Hostel Caution Money
questions.explanation: The processing fee covers administrative costs and is generally non-refundable once paid.

questions.question_text: Under the FJWU fee structure, how are 'Semester Fees' typically billed?
options: Once every two years
Per semester at the start of the term
Monthly throughout the year
At the end of the degree
questions.explanation: Semester fees are due at the commencement of each academic session to maintain enrollment.

questions.question_text: If a student applies for a leave of absence, how is their previously paid semester fee handled?
options: It is automatically transferred to the next academic year
It is forfeited by the university
It is refundable in full
It depends on the university's specific financial policy on withdrawals
questions.explanation: Fee policies for withdrawals or leaves are subject to specific university bylaws regarding refunds or credits.

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of the 'Library Fee' often included in the semester charges?
options: To fund student cafeteria meals
To cover the maintenance and acquisition of library resources
To pay for building electricity
To provide free stationery for all students
questions.explanation: Library fees are specifically earmarked for enhancing the research and learning facilities available to students.

questions.question_text: Can the University update the fee structure for incoming batches?
options: No, fees are frozen for eternity
Yes, fees are subject to revision by the Finance and Planning Committee
Only the Government can change fees, not the university
Only with the approval of each individual student
questions.explanation: Public universities reserve the right to revise fee structures based on inflationary trends and administrative costs.
